architectural_units.name: Frontend
architectural_units.description: The mobile application developed with Flutter that acts as the presentation layer, managing the graphical interface, navigation, and user interaction.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The server-side software responsible for processing business logic, data persistence, and integration with external services.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Manages the application state and communication with the user interface using Bloc/Cubit.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Contains business logic, with use cases, entities, and repositories defined as interfaces.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Handles data access, including backend calls, data transformation, and concrete repository implementation.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Contains the purest business logic of the system, domain models, and repository interfaces, independent of Django or the database.

architectural_units.name: Application Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Includes system use cases that orchestrate business logic and define the flow of operations.

architectural_units.name: Infrastructure Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Responsible for interaction with the exterior, including Django HTTP views, ORM repositories, and external service adapters.

architectural_units.name: Flutter
architectural_units.description: Framework used for cross-platform mobile application development.

architectural_units.name: Django
architectural_units.description: Framework used as the main backend for building the REST API.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used for data persistence.

architectural_units.name: AI Service
architectural_units.description: External service for generating intelligent responses (Cintia).

architectural_units.name: Gemini
architectural_units.description: AI service provider used for generating responses.

architectural_units.name: ChatGPT
architectural_units.description: AI service provider used for generating responses.

architectural_units.name: Firebase
architectural_units.description: Used for complementary functionalities like notifications and associated services.

architectural_units.name: REST API
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol between frontend and backend using JSON.

The frontend (mobile application) performs requests to the backend to obtain or modify information. [...] The communication between the front-end and the back-end is carried out through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.
The backend uses the Django ORM to access the MySQL database for data persistence.
The backend integrates external AI services like Gemini and ChatGPT through specific adapters located in the infrastructure layer.
The backend integrates Firebase for complementary functionalities like notifications and associated services.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The system interaction is performed through a mobile application (frontend) that makes requests to a backend server.

patterns.name: Hexagonal Architecture
patterns.description: The backend follows the Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters) pattern, which allows separating business logic from the framework and infrastructure technologies.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture
patterns.description: The frontend follows the principles of Clean Architecture, applied strictly to organize code into Presentation, Domain, and Data layers.

patterns.name: Repository Pattern
patterns.description: Isolates data access and simplifies the use of the ORM in use cases.

patterns.name: Factory Pattern
patterns.description: Used to dynamically instantiate artificial intelligence services according to system configuration.

patterns.name: Dependency Inversion (DIP)
patterns.description: The domain defines interfaces that are implemented by the infrastructure.
